# Router and Sidebar Rules

## Sync invariants

- Every page component used in router must exist under `src/pages/`.
- Every sidebar item path should map to a router child route.
- First page defaults to index route (`/`).

## Naming

- Page file: `<PageName>Page.tsx`
- Route path: kebab-case (`OrdersPage` -> `/orders`)

## Read before editing

- `.github/skills/_shared/components/router.md`
- `.github/skills/_shared/components/navigation.md`
- `.github/skills/_shared/templates/multi-page/README.md`
